PSA_updates.text: e Account An Update on Service Levels at PSA More people are collecting, trading, and enjoying cards than ever before, and that growth has increased submission volume and made turnaround times harder to estimate. To better align volume with grading capacity and support more predictable expectations, we are reopening service levels in phases and updating estimated turnaround times for new submissions. On October 29, Value returns, [...] s improve. Updated details are outlined below. Value Bulk, our Collectors Club-only bulk service for all categories including TCG, remains paused. We’re committed to reopening it, and we’ll share our progress along the way. Pricing Updates for New Submissions Pricing for the following service levels is increasing: Value: $39.99 per card Standard: $59.99 per card Priority: $79.99 per card Estimated Turnaround Time Updates for New Submissions The Estimated Turnaround Times for the following service levels are increasing: Value: 90–100 business days Standard: 90–100 → 70–80 business days Priority: 70–80 → 50–60 business days Prices and Estimated Turnaround Times for Express and higher service levels remain unchanged.
